## 2. Styling & UI Architecture Audit

- **CSS Entrypoint:** `src/index.css` configured with `@import "tailwindcss";` and custom Karnataka design tokens (`--accent-gold`, `--accent-terracotta`, `--karnataka-red`, `--karnataka-yellow`, `--stone-dark`).
- **Tailwind Setup:** `@tailwindcss/vite` v4.0.0 configured directly in `vite.config.ts`.
- **Reduced-Motion Baseline:** System adheres to WCAG 2.2 AA reduced motion constraints (`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`) for smooth accessibility compliance.
- **Conflicting Frameworks:** Zero legacy frameworks (Bootstrap, Material UI, Chakra UI, Ant Design are absent). UI primitives are purely native HTML5 + Tailwind CSS v4 + Lucide icons.

---

## 3. Map & Routing Providers Audit

- **Tile Engine:** `maplibre-gl` v6.16.0.
- **Terrain Provider:** MapTiler raster-dem (`https://api.maptiler.com/tiles/terrain-rgb-v2/{z}/{x}/{y}.webp?key=...`) configured with fallback elevation calculation.
- **Routing Engine:** Open Source Routing Machine (`OSRM`) public endpoints with local deterministic fallback calculation in `src/services/karnatakaRoadRoutingService.ts` and `src/services/detourCalculationService.ts`.
- **API Key Security:** Zero committed secrets. All external services consume `import.meta.env.VITE_*` environment variables documented in `.env.example`.

## 4. Dead Controls & Unwired State Scan
